paragraphs: R' Shmuel bar Adda said, “Hananyah my brother says”: Arvei Pesahim, 104a; there, bar Idi. He, Rav Huna bar Manoah, and R' Hiyya of Vestanya were before Rava, and afterward before Rav Pappa; see his entry.
